name: com.unity.demoteam.hair
description: MHBridge Importer fork of com.unity.demoteam.hair. Includes Unity 6.3+ fixes and skin attachment without additional dependencies. An integrated solution for authoring / importing / simulating / rendering strand-based hair in Unity.

samples.description: Interactive scene featuring a simple hair setup. Contains variants for all current rendering pipelines: HDRP, URP, and Built-in.
